records.text: A Spectator UK article argued that COVID-19 was established to mirror a religion.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I mean, it had, there was actually a really good article on the spectrum. In the Spectator UK regarding how they tried to establish COVID to mirror a religion.

verification.notes: The Spectator Australia published an article titled 'Covidanity: Australia's new state religion' arguing that COVID compliance resembled a religion and comparing masks and other measures to religious symbols and rituals. However, it was an Australian-edition opinion article and did not establish that COVID-19 itself was intentionally created or established to mirror religion, so Owens's paraphrase overstates it.

sources.title: Covidanity: Australia's new state religion
sources.relevance: The cited Spectator Australia opinion article makes the religion analogy but does not prove intentional establishment of COVID to mirror religion.
